reusable_observations.observation: A candidate that elaborates can still change cycle-visible control behavior.
reusable_observations.action: Run differential verification before spending EDA time; preserve the first mismatching cycle and port verbatim.

reusable_observations.observation: A failed edit remains valuable feedback only when the next turn can see the exact source state and raw failure.
reusable_observations.action: Retain candidate diff, stage, raw error and parent identity; allow an explicit revert to baseline or best valid source.

reusable_observations.observation: Source structure alone is insufficient to establish the physical bottleneck.
reusable_observations.action: Let the agent inspect unannotated timing paths and generated RTL, then require measured post-synthesis deltas.

reusable_observations.observation: Search-time success can be affected by cached workspaces and a single random stimulus stream.
reusable_observations.action: Finalize from a clean workspace with new differential seeds, post-route PPA and a processor-level program regression.

reusable_observations.observation: A persistent tool session can recover from an invalid first candidate without human source repair.
reusable_observations.action: Keep the agent's observation history and tool outputs in one logical session while enforcing an EDA evaluation budget.
